categories.label: Core Icons

categories.label: Camera Icons
categories.description: Camera types and live status used on the map and in camera detail views.

categories.label: Detection Icons
categories.description: Objects the system can detect or flag: vehicles, people, and incidents.

categories.label: Privacy Icons
categories.description: Data-handling and protection states: what is hidden, encrypted, processed locally, or removable.

categories.label: Status Icons
categories.description: Generic system/UI state indicators, reusable outside the map context.

categories.label: UI Icons
categories.description: Chrome and controls: navigation, view options, and generic actions.

categories.label: Hero Assets
categories.description: Larger reusable illustration components (not flat icons) used to compose 04-Hero-Illustration and future scenes.

categories.label: Brand Assets
categories.description: Logo lockups and platform icon exports (favicon, app icon, Safari mask icon).
